L: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Northfield Home and Garden Fair.
Please note that the cooking demonstration scheduled for three o'clock has been moved from the main stage to Hall C because of a problem with the stage lighting.
The demonstration will now begin at three thirty.
Visitors who bought tickets for the demonstration should bring them to the entrance of Hall C.
While you wait, free samples of local cheese are being offered at the Dairy Council stand near the north entrance.
Thank you, and enjoy the fair.
